<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit\__MODULE__\Application\UseCase\__FLOW_TYPE__\__AREA__\__USE_CASE__;

use __MODULE__\Application\Port\Outbound\__REPOSITORY_PORT__;
use __MODULE__\Application\UseCase\__FLOW_TYPE__\__AREA__\__USE_CASE__\{__MESSAGE_CLASS__, __HANDLER_CLASS__, __RESULT_CLASS__};
use InvalidArgumentException;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\{CoversClass, Test};
use PHPUnit\Framework\MockObject\MockObject;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

#[CoversClass(__HANDLER_CLASS__::class)]
final class __HANDLER_CLASS__Test extends TestCase
{
  #[Test]
  public function testInvokeReturnsExpectedResultOnSuccess(): void
  {
    /** @var __REPOSITORY_PORT__&MockObject $repository */
    $repository = $this->createMock(__REPOSITORY_PORT__::class);

    $handler = new __HANDLER_CLASS__(
      repository: $repository,
    );

    $result = $handler->__invoke(new __MESSAGE_CLASS__(
      __MESSAGE_ARGUMENTS__
    ));

    self::assertInstanceOf(__RESULT_CLASS__::class, $result);
    __SUCCESS_ASSERTIONS__
  }

  #[Test]
  public function testInvokeThrowsOnInvalidInput(): void
  {
    /** @var __REPOSITORY_PORT__&MockObject $repository */
    $repository = $this->createMock(__REPOSITORY_PORT__::class);

    $handler = new __HANDLER_CLASS__(
      repository: $repository,
    );

    $this->expectException(InvalidArgumentException::class);
    $this->expectExceptionMessage('__EXPECTED_EXCEPTION_MESSAGE__');

    $handler->__invoke(new __MESSAGE_CLASS__(
      __INVALID_MESSAGE_ARGUMENTS__
    ));
  }
}
